summary: Order Management Phase 1 Testing - ALL TESTS PASS (12/12 backend, 100% frontend). Order-to-Cash lifecycle features fully functional: POST /api/order-lifecycle/orders creates orders with PID, budget, and timeline; GET /api/order-lifecycle/orders returns orders with lifecycle data; GET /api/projects/next-pid generates PIDs in format PID/FY/number. Frontend Order Management page has two working tabs with Add New Order modal.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/order-lifecycle/orders correctly stores budget fields (purchase_budget, execution_budget, others_budget, target_profit) in both financials and lifecycle objects
Timeline fields (start_date, end_date, deadline) correctly stored in lifecycle.timeline object
PID generation endpoint returns correct format PID/FY/number (e.g., PID/25-26/394)
Duplicate PID validation working - returns 400 error for existing PIDs
GET /api/order-lifecycle/orders returns enriched orders with lifecycle and financials data
Frontend Add New Order modal has all required sections: Project Identification, Customer Information, Budget Allocation, Timeline, Order Items
seed_data_creation: Test orders created with TEST_ prefix during testing
